testimonials.quote: Standing at the rostrum in Kaduna State University representing my delegation rewrote how I understand diplomacy. Under High Commissioner Suleiman Yusuf Othman's visionary leadership, GILD teaches us that African students can master sovereign negotiations and shape international policy.
testimonials.author: Fatima Abubakar Sadiq
testimonials.title: Delegate / Diplomat, Class of 2026

testimonials.quote: The collaborative energy between the Department of International Relations & Diplomacy and the Department of Political Science makes GILD the premier diplomatic simulation platform in Northern Nigeria. We drafted real resolutions on ECOWAS security that matter.
testimonials.author: Ibrahim Danjuma
testimonials.title: Chief Delegate, African Union Committee

testimonials.quote: GILD International and ASIRS gave us an institutional voice. From Kaduna to Abuja, we are cultivating a new generation of principled envoys who understand international law, diplomacy, and sovereign dignity.
testimonials.author: Zainab Bello
testimonials.title: Rapporteur General
testimonials.country: Dept of International Relations & Diplomacy, KASU
